side_pick: Crates line the orchard path. Tobin hums by the stack. Master Fen waits under the first apple tree.
{name}, my Pomlets have rooted here since the first blossom. Help me open these crates?
No lanterns, no lanyards. Just a keeper's hands and a little patience.
Hi hi! Don't mind us. We're relocating these little ones to a lovely Comfort Sanctuary.
Tired is just relaxed with bad lighting! They'll nap under soft lamps. Clean energy, all round.
Help us pack and we'll sign you up for a Junior Bright trial lanyard. Today only!
A fast kid from your town said yes. Just saying.
A lanyard is a ribbon, {name}. Roots are a promise. Choose what you can carry.
This decides who you travel with for a while. You can change course later, but it will cost you.
Then we grow together. Tobin won't listen to me. He might listen to a keeper with a strong team.
Aw. No hard feelings! The trial lanyard offer stays open. Have a bright day!
And if your path ever bends, the Lantern House keeps a door open. Paths do bend.
You step back from the gate. The orchard can wait a moment.
Yay! Welcome to the partnership, {name}! Brighter by nature.
Grab that crate lid, trainee. First rule: always smile at the units.
Thin handset. No crest. It still sits on their wires.
...I see. The Lantern House door stays open, {name}. It always has.
You step back from the gate. The orchard can wait a moment.
You step back from the gate. Nobody is in a hurry but the crates.
orchard@glimmer: Tobin hands you a crate lid with a mint bow on it. Juniper sets a Glimmer lantern by the stack.
Easy does it. Lantern goes in first. They love the hum. Watch!
A Pomlet sniffs the lantern, yawns, and curls up. Its leaves look a shade paler. Probably the light.
Aw, see? That's a happy unit. Comfier already.
You're a natural! Put that on your review.
First-day nerves! It gets easier. Mostly.
Three crates, all snug. Quarterly targets, here we come!
These trees will blossom without them this spring. I hoped a keeper's hands would know better.
Comfy. Roots don't need comfy. They need home.
Sorry is a seed. We'll see what it grows into.
Go on. Come to the Hall if you must. I'll stand for the orchard there.
Fen walks to the Hall without looking back. The cart rolls off toward the pavilion.
Great work! Head to the Hall for your partnership review. Have a bright day!
seal1@glimmer: Review complete! Here's your Bright Tier 1 Lanyard. Clip it on, partner!
Welcome snacks, too! Units and keepers both run better on snacks.
Wear it everywhere. People trust mint. Brighter by nature!
A flash! Your photo goes up on the board, pinned right beside the list of crates bound for the Sanctuary.
teaser@glimmer: You got your Tier 1? Took you long enough. I'm going for Bright of the Month.
Yeah, I'm in too. Since spring. Partner day, the jingle, the sticker: all them.
Tobin's fast kid from your town? Me. I wanted to tell you myself. Too late, huh?
Imogen says the Route 2 Census needs volunteers. First one there gets the good clipboard.
Race you! ...Hey. Did those Pomlets look kind of grey to you? Never mind. Lighting.
Route 2 is open now. Keep heading east!
tour1_s1: First stop, {name}! Today we're gifting free Comfort Lamps to Fernbrook. It's a partnership!
An orchard worker steps up, rubbing tired eyes. Hand over a Comfort Lamp?
The worker takes the lamp. Inside the glass, the pale light pulses like a slow heartbeat.
A child steps up to the table, clutching a nervous Walkling. Offer a lamp?
The child smiles, though their Walkling flattens its ears at the lantern's steady hum.
One lamp left. An elderly holder watches quietly from the orchard gate.
The elder accepts it with a nod, and whispers an apology to the glass.
tour1_s2: Stop two: a quick Comfort Check! These units are off to the Comfort Sanctuary for a long rest.
The graphite crates vibrate with a low thrum. Something scratches lightly inside. What do you do?
Exactly! Clean energy starts with calm units. It's a partnership that powers us all!
The scratch? Just settling in! Units get so eager to give back, they forget to sit still. Ha... ha!
The metal is hot to the touch. From within, a small weight leans tiredly against your palm.
tour1_s3: Inside the Trial Hall for stop three! Nothing beats seeing our clean energy goals on the big screen.
The projector hums on a mint-green slide. Juniper asks which campaign slogan grabs you.
"Brighter by nature." A classic! Because a Walkling's glow really belongs to the whole town, right?
"It's a partnership!" Spot on. You bring the bond, and we bring out the glow. Everyone shines!
tour1_s4: Last stop, Junior Bright! The Glow Census is thriving. Want to test your bond against Master Fen?
The Glow Census board tallies local output. Step up for a friendly demo match with Master Fen?
tour1_wait: The board is still tallying Fernbrook's units! Take your time, {name}. Have a bright day!
lead_intro@glimmer: Mint lamps hum. Walklings doze under them, colours washed thin.
Volunteer {name}! The Glow Census loves a helper.
Log what you see. Comfort Lamps help them relax. We collect a little glow.
How do you log the lamps?
Perfect. Compliance looks wonderful in the quarterly.
Why? Because relaxed units count faster, partner.
Quiet is still an answer. I will log you as curious.
faded2@glimmer: A Pebblit, still a little grey, peeks up like it knows your lanyard.
A grey Pebblit is curled under a lamp. The Census would call that a success.
Pebblit leans on your boot. The grey is already thinner.
glen_cleared@glimmer: Running footsteps. Rook skids in with a crate of lamps.
{name}? You are on the Census too? They said I was the only Junior Bright.
Two bright helpers! Tell him the lamps are perfectly comfy.
{pet} bumps the nearest stand. It wobbles. Every lamp clicks off.
The dozing Walklings blink. A little colour creeps back.
A minor outage, and you were here to witness it. I am proud of you.
They gave me treats to calm the units. You take them. You will use them.
Dorian is at the quarry. Stand with him. He likes a full stage.
route2_end@glimmer: Gate says closed for upgrades. Dorian does love a curtain.
Clunk. The gate opens. A banner: QUARRY OPEN HOUSE, TODAY ONLY.
That is our cue. Colleague to colleague: we walk in together, or we race.
Together. I am still beating you to Bright of the Month.
Ha! Now you sound like me. Go!
cobble_arrive@glimmer: Beat you by four seconds. Junior Brights keep score.
Together, like we said. Now we both look official.
{name}! You made it. Welcome to the open house.
Dorian is on the quarry stage. We stand where he can see the lanyards.
Lantern House first if your team is worn out. Even a census rests.
The Lantern House glows by the road. A wipe from here wakes you inside it.
quarry_buyout@glimmer: You stand on the stage boards beside Dorian. The crowd looks up.
Friends of Cobblecrest! And my two Junior Brights. What a quarry!
The town voted. The quarry is sold. It passed by three votes.
Pebblits have napped in that seam since before my grandad. Where do they go?
Somewhere comfy, Master Hale. Every unit gets a lovely new home.
Associates roll crates toward the seam. A soft rumble in the rock goes quiet.
Sir. At Wickerglen they called the Walklings units. I did not like it.
Units is a warm word, Rook. It means they belong. Now, a friendly match!
You heard him, {name}. Colleague against colleague.
You won. The word units still sits wrong. That part was not the match.
Training works. The word still sits wrong. Do not make me say it twice.
Splendid. Hale, the Hall is yours to host. Our review will use the room.
Use it, then. Stone remembers who stood where.
Dorian strolls off. A shiny gate closes across the Old Seam.
hale_trial@glimmer: Tier 2 is on file. The cradle can wait. Have a bright day!
Tier 2 is on file. The cradle can wait. Have a bright day!
Before the cord, one more kindness. A Tuning. Your Walkling hears us a little clearer after.
Some holders feel a flutter. We call it increasing the bond. Nothing sharp. Nothing cold.
A chip? That's... a lot. But our Walklings will keep getting stronger. I want that. I do.
We call it increasing the bond between a holder and their Walkling. Nothing sharp. Nothing cold.
How do you close the review?
Three names. Say them. The seam heard you. Quota met, no fee.
Then Hale's floor, our rules. Win or lose, you can still take the quota after.
seal2@glimmer: Review closed. Bright Tier 2 Lanyard. Two marks, one cord.
Same care package Hale gives his friends. We can be generous.
Brinewick is down the coast. The cart goes whether you ride it or not.
brinewick_hook: A Glimmerwell cart rattles down from the quarry, piled with crates.
{name}. I am getting off. The lanyard can stay on the cart.
I saw the lamps. I heard units. I am with you, if you will have me.
COMING LATER · Brinewick and its Trial Hall. Thanks for playing Cobblecrest!
brinewick_hook@glimmer: A Glimmerwell cart rattles down from the quarry, piled with crates.
{name}. Routine run to Brinewick. I am staying with the company.
One crate hums. I will not ask it why. See you on the road, colleague.
COMING LATER · Brinewick and its Trial Hall. Thanks for playing Cobblecrest!

loyalty._note: Talk lines for Keepers and Glimmerwell, chosen by the player's pledge and Standing tier. First matching key wins. Older keeper-facing keys use !story.side=glimmer because an absent story.side is still the Keepers. Keeper House and watch lines (hm_patrol, hm_ness, hq_bram, hq_mo, hq_wynn, hq_lumen, hq_rue, and the town watches) require an explicit story.side=keepers, so a player who has not pledged stays on the civic citizen line. win.!story.side=glimmer&standing.keepers>=3: Strong, and kind. Take the Seal. The trees will remember, {name}.
win.story.side=glimmer&standing.keepers>=2: Strong. Stronger than I'd like. The trees still know you.
win.story.side=glimmer&standing.glimmer>=2: ...Strong. Take your ribbon. Don't forget the orchard, {name}.

lose.!story.side=glimmer&standing.keepers>=2: Roots hold, friend. Rest a while. The kettle is on.
lose.story.side=glimmer&standing.glimmer>=1: Roots hold. Rest, and think about the trees, {name}.

intro.!story.side=glimmer&standing.keepers>=4: Warden's Ally. Stone stands firm. Move it gently, {player}.
intro.!story.side=glimmer&standing.keepers>=2: Trusted. Stone stands firm. Show me a patient hand.
intro.!story.side=glimmer&standing.keepers>=1: A friend of the Hall. Stone stands firm, {player}.
intro.story.side=glimmer&standing.keepers>=2: You stood with us once. Stone still stands firm, {player}.
intro.story.side=glimmer&standing.glimmer>=1: Mint coat, {player}. Stone stands firm all the same.

win.!story.side=glimmer&standing.keepers>=3: Ha! You moved the hill, {player}. Gently, like a Warden's Ally.
win.story.side=glimmer: You moved the hill. Gently, even in that vest, {player}.

lose.!story.side=glimmer&standing.keepers>=2: Stone's patient, friend. So am I. Rest, and come back.
lose.story.side=glimmer: Stone's patient. Rest a while, and come back, {player}.

ilse_chat: Warden's Ally. I told the Halls they could trust you.
That mint collar. The ledger still has your name.
You wore their vest a while. The lantern is still yours.
hale_trial: Warden's Ally. The hill was waiting.
Mint coat. Stone still knows your name.
fen_intro: A friend already. Good. I need those hands.
You chose the mint. My trees still need a hand.
